newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merck Aggrastat news seen positive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merck Aggrastat news seen positive.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said analyst Mariola Haggar views results presented Monday from studies of Merck & Co Inc's Aggrastat for unstable angina as "surprisingly positive."
-- said her earnings models assume that the drug will be approved for unstable angina but believes her earnings estimates are "extremely conservative."
-- estimates 1997 earnings $3.80 a share, compared with $3.20 in 1996.
-- estimates 1998 earnings $4.45 a share, 1999 earnings $5.15 a share.
